description: This file contains functions and types for handling legacy voice call configuration, including migration, validation, and warning generation, with references to external config schemas and types.

classes.name: VoiceCallLegacyConfigIssue
classes.description: Type representing issues found in legacy voice call configuration, including path, replacement, and message.

methods.name: collectVoiceCallLegacyConfigIssues
methods.description: Analyzes a configuration object and returns a list of issues related to legacy keys and structure.

methods.name: formatVoiceCallLegacyConfigWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages for legacy config issues, including a command to fix them.

methods.name: migrateVoiceCallLegacyConfigInput
methods.description: Converts legacy config input into a normalized config object, tracking changes and issues.

methods.name: normalizeVoiceCallLegacyConfigInput
methods.description: Simplifies migration by normalizing input config into a standard format.

methods.name: parseVoiceCallPluginConfig
methods.description: Parses and validates the final voice call plugin configuration using a schema.
